project.name: 深空宇宙
project.designRead: immersive cosmic landing / tech-savvy audience / cinematic-deep / visual-driven / avoid generic SaaS dark template
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Deep space cosmic immersive page: deep blue-black base, nebula blue/purple ambient, ice-blue highlights, Inter typography, cinematic depth with multi-layer parallax, canvas-based star field and cosmic object, glass panels, scroll storytelling.
styleContinuityAnchors: Deep space dark base (#020617) with blue/purple nebula ambient layers
Inter font family throughout, tight letter-spacing on display headings
Glass panels: rgba(7,12,28,0.45) background, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border, 12-24px blur
Cosmic buttons: semi-transparent dark, ultra-thin border, soft glow, arrow icon
Canvas-based star field with multiple depth layers and parallax
Slow, continuous, cinematic motion (cubic-bezier easing, 1-2s transitions)

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: static surfaces use border/surface layering; floating layers (glass panels) may use deeper elevation with blur

styleConstraints.colorPolicy: 80% dark background, 15% blue-purple ambient, 5% ice-blue/white highlights

pages.title: 深空宇宙
pages.visualNorthStar: Cinematic deep space entry: full-viewport hero with canvas-based cosmic object, multi-layer star field, nebula ambient, parallax depth, scroll storytelling through space
pages.compositionPattern: asymmetric-hero: title left/center, cosmic object right/background, generous dark margins, scroll hint at bottom; subsequent sections use alternating large-visual + text layout with floating glass panels

componentPlan: CosmicBackground: fixed multi-layer background (deep space base, nebula CSS gradients, canvas star field, dust particles)
NavigationBar: transparent → glass on scroll, lightweight, thin text
HeroSection: full viewport, large title with fade-in, subtitle, cosmic object canvas, CTA buttons, scroll hint
CosmicObject: canvas-based rotating sphere/orb with glow, orbits, particles, mouse parallax
ScrollStorySection: multiple sections with floating glass panels, space node decorations, scroll-triggered reveal
FooterSection: stars fading, center star, minimal content
ParallaxController: multi-layer mouse + scroll parallax with smooth interpolation
ReducedMotionSupport: prefers-reduced-motion media query, performance optimization
